template: On dashboard '{{v1}}' (uid {{v3}}): set the dashboard time range to 'Last 6 hours' (via the top time picker), add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard (via Dashboard settings → General → Tags), and when saving, make sure the save dialog option to update the dashboard's default time range IS ticked so the 6-hour range persists in the saved dashboard. Save. Then verify persistence: reload the page, open Dashboard settings → General and confirm the tag 'bench' is listed, and confirm the saved default time range is Last 6 hours (e.g. by opening a fresh new browser tab to the dashboard and checking the time picker, or checking the settings' time range). Report what you observe.
